title: SEC tokenized stock framework faces issuer pushback as Broadcom, Verizon object to OKX-ICE listing
summary: Eight more companies objected to trading on the planned OKX-ICE venue, while Nasdaq has separately said it would opt out under the SEC’s framework.

title: The White House's crypto chief departs: State of Crypto
summary: Patrick Witt announced his departure from the White House last week.

title: Wall Street freaked out Friday, but VIX and bitcoin trades say the fear may fade Monday.
summary: Wall Street's fear gauge, the VIX index, spiked on Friday as stocks dropped. History says Friday panics usually fade on Monday. Seasonality and calm bitcoin markets suggest the same.

title: Latvia eyes crypto tax payments in 2027 as parliament overhauls crypto taxation
summary: Parliament passed a law taxing crypto withdrawals above deposits rather than individual trades, featuring a one-time declaration mechanism.

title: Stablecoin supply stalls, but payments jump 45% as Visa, Mastercard and Stripe connect crypto to cash
summary: Analytics firm Allium said stablecoin payments hit $482 billion this year so far, up 45%, as card spending surges and global payment firms add crypto rails.
